verified.headline: Agreed to a five-year, $260 million contract with the Ravens
verified.description: Jackson and the Ravens agreed to a five-year, $260 million deal ($185 million in total guarantees, $135 million fully guaranteed at signing, $72.5 million signing bonus) on April 27, 2023, while he was under the non-exclusive franchise tag. The club's transaction log records the signing on May 4, 2023.

Lamar Jackson, Ravens agree on five-year, $260 million extension

facts.notes: April 27 is the agreement date (AP: 'agreed in principle'); the official log shows the signing on May 4, 2023. Either say 'Agreed to' on 4/27 or move 'Signed' to 5/4. $185M is total guarantees (only $135M fully guaranteed at signing). He was on the unsigned 2023 franchise tag, so this was a new five-year deal (2023-2027) rather than years added to an existing contract, though the Ravens' log calls it an extension. Drop any 'highest-paid' wording.
